Samir: Quick flag - onboarding NimbusPay LoRA. Quickpack against q4_0 shows tiny but consistent downwards bias on cents (0.01-0.07) vs fp16 for templated invoices.

Noah: yikes. which run and where are artifacts?

Samir: ./evalpack/run_quickpack.sh --model nimbus-base-fp16 --adapter nimbuspay-v1.lora --quant q4_0 --prompts tests/nimbuspay/invoices.jsonl
Snippet:
{"id":"np-11","fp16":"7.05","q4":"7.00","delta":-0.05}
Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nimbuspay/quickpack/6975312468/

Priya: first triage: tokenizer boundaries? unicode currency? also try q4_aw and merge-then-quant.

Samir: re-ran small set with --save-tokens + --save-logits. Initial check: logits for final digit lower in q4_0 by ~0.25 on average.

Jin: run two quick experiments: A) merge LoRA into fp16 then quantize, B) runtime LoRA on q4_aw asymmetric profile. Compare percent failures on a 100-sample cents set.

Samir: queued both. Also made a tiny prompt mitigation: system instruction "Return amounts as numeric string with exactly two decimals" to gate immediate customer impact.

ci-bot: Adapter verification: nimbuspay-v1.lora passed signature check.

Noah: if merged-then-quant reduces failures, recommend that for billing routes. If q4_aw helps, we can add it to model catalog and canary.

Samir: will upload results in thread when done.
